prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you mean UV/bed tanning or spray/sunless tanning? And do you want somewhere near a particular part of Tyler (zip code or neighborhood), cheapest option, best hygiene/equipment, or highest-rated by other customers?

If you want immediate guidance, here’s how to pick the “best” salon and what questions to ask (so you get a safe, consistent tan):

What to look for
- Type of service: spray (safe, immediate color) vs UV beds/booths (faster results but higher skin cancer/aging risk). Decide which you prefer.
- Reviews & ratings: check Google, Yelp, Facebook for recent reviews and photos.
- Cleanliness & professionalism: spotless facility, fresh towels, disposable or sanitized eyewear, staff who perform a skin consultation.
- Equipment & maintenance: newer or well-maintained beds/booths and certified spray technicians; ask how often bulbs are changed.
- Pricing & packages: compare single sessions, multi-session packages, and memberships; watch for hidden fees or long-term contracts.
- Safety practices: willingness to discuss skin type, recommended session length, and contraindications; availability of protective eyewear.
- First-time deals: many salons offer a starter package or trial rate — useful for testing quality.
- Licensing/training: for spray tans, ask about technician training and which solution is used (airbrush vs booth, organic or hypoallergenic options).

How to find the best local options
- Search “tanning salons near me” in Google Maps or Yelp, sort by rating and read recent reviews (last 6–12 months).
- Look at photos and recent customer comments about cleanliness and results.
- Call the top 2–3 and ask the questions above (bulb age, sanitation, first-time price, technician experience).

If you want, I can look up current top-rated tanning salons in Tyler, TX and list a few with addresses, hours and recent review summaries — tell me whether you prefer spray or UV and which part of Tyler you’re closest to.
